note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 operator manual TM 9-2320-272-10 (M939/A1/A2 series, Change 2 of September 2004). It holds the M939A1 M929A1 truck (M939A1 series) as a wheeled entry. The manual publishes no operating weight, no named curb weight, no net power and no tyre width or diameter, so the entry is not runtime-ready. Every dimension comes from a table that prints both inch and centimetre figures; the published centimetre figure is recorded converted to millimetres. The maker is unknown because the manual names no manufacturer.
